subject: Mutual plan playbook — starter MAP + slides for Aurelia Health evaluation
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Michael Stone <michael.stone@aurelia.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T15:24:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual plan playbook — starter MAP + slides for Aurelia Health evaluation

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday — really energized by the clinical ops use case you walked us through. Per our conversation, I put together a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) starter that maps the evaluation milestones to owners, success criteria, and a proposed 6-week close timeline.

What's in the draft:
- 6-week evaluation checkpoints (pilot goals, success metrics, infra checklist)
- Stakeholder owners (Clinical Ops, IT Security, Data Engineering)
- Key deliverables & acceptance criteria for each milestone
- Decision / procurement gating items and suggested dates

I attached a short slide pack (MAP-starter-slides-v1.pptx) and created a living Google Doc for collaborative edits: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbcGMapDraft. The doc is editable by your team if you want to add stakeholders or move dates.

As next steps, can we lock a 60-minute MAP workshop with the core stakeholders next week? I propose Wed 12/2 or Thurs 12/3 (US PT afternoon). Goal: align on owners, confirm minimal pilot scope, and surface any procurement blockers.

Also tagging procurement early — Priya, if you can highlight any internal procurement or security artifacts you need on our side (sample contracts, SOC2 evidence, SSO/KMS notes), we'll queue those right after the workshop.

Thanks,

--
Dev Patel
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: MAP-starter-slides-v1.pptx (10 slides — outline + timeline + roles)

From: Michael Stone <michael.stone@aurelia.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <procurement@aurelia-health.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan playbook — starter MAP + slides for Aurelia Health evaluation

Dev,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear structure. I reviewed the slides and the doc — looks like a good starting point. Wed 12/2 at 1:00 PM PT works for me. Please invite: myself (Clinical AI), Priya (procurement), Arun Patel (Infrastructure), and Lila Chen (Data Engineering).

A couple quick asks before the workshop:
- Can you add a short row in the MAP for "Data access & sample size" with expected artifacts (schema, sample anonymized extract)?
- We typically need an estimated TCO range for the pilot (ballpark monthly cost). If you can add a placeholder, we can refine after the workshop.

Priya — any pre-work procurement checklist you want us to complete before 12/2?

Thanks,
Michael

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple procurement-related items we'll need before any PO:
1) Fully executed MSA or a draft we can redline (PDF preferred)
2) SOC 2 Type II report and an inventory of subservice providers
3) Short note on data residency and retention (we operate under HIPAA constraints)
4) An initial SOW template with pilot acceptance criteria and payment milestones

If you can attach the MSA draft and SOC2 evidence to the doc or send as separate attachments before the workshop that would speed things up. Priya

Thanks all — calendar invite sent for Wed 2026-12-02 13:00 PT (60m): MAP workshop (Aurelia Health).

Quick status update before the workshop:
- Google Doc updated: added "Data access & sample size" row and placeholder TCO range per Marissa's estimates (link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbcGMapDraft).
- Uploaded a draft MSA and SOC2 stub to the doc references (see attachments area). If procurement needs PDFs I can email directly after the workshop.
- Attached: final MAP starter slides (MAP-starter-slides-v1.pptx) and the editable GDoc reference (Aurelia-MAP-template-v1.gdoc).

Agenda for the workshop (proposed):
1) Quick goals and success criteria (10m)
2) Data & infra gating items (15m)
3) Pilot scope and acceptance tests (20m)
4) Procurement & timeline to PO (10m)
5) Action owners and next steps (5m)

Please add anything I missed directly in the doc. Looking forward to aligning and getting a scoped pilot running.

Best,
Dev
